evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the progress bar
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the progress bar" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the progress bar
sections.description: Sets the empty space, in pixels, on each side of the progress bar: top, right, bottom, left. The default is usually 0 for a tight bar that sits close to your content; add top and bottom padding to give it room from the title or image above and below. On an ad funnel a progress bar with a little breathing room reads as a quick, low-effort flow, which keeps people moving forward.
